agent.description: Agent slug — basename (without .md) of the agent identity file under .kody/agents/.

thread.description: Where to post the reply: `discussion:<n>` (or a bare number) for a Discussion, or `issue:<n>` for an issue/PR. When set, the agent answers as a comment on that thread.

message.description: Fallback inline message when no triggering comment body is available (CLI/testing). In production the message is read verbatim from the dispatching comment body.
